name: Exp_MA_Rounding_Channel
summary: This EA trades breakouts from a MA Rounding Channel, which is built around a rounded moving average with ATR-based channel bands. It opens buy positions when price closes above the upper channel and sell positions when price closes below the lower channel, with exit signals triggered when the channel disappears or price re-enters the channel.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MA圆整通道进行突破交易，通道由圆整移动平均线和ATR偏差带构成。价格收于上轨上方时做多，收于下轨下方时做空，当通道消失或价格回到通道内时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于MA圆整通道突破，通道由经过圆整处理的移动平均线加上ATR倍数构成的上下轨组成。入场条件为：当已收盘K线同时存在上下通道值时，收盘价突破上轨则产生买入信号，突破下轨则产生卖出信号；同时要求前一根K线无通道或价格未突破，以确保是首次突破。出场条件分为两种：当通道存在时，反向突破触发平仓；当通道消失时，EA会向后搜索最近的通道上轨或下轨，判断价格是否仍处于突破状态以决定是否平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值为固定手数，正值为按存款比例计算。资金管理设有固定的止损和止盈点数，但没有根据ATR或波动率动态调整止损止盈的机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on breakout trading from an MA Rounding Channel, which consists of a rounded moving average line plus ATR-multiplied upper and lower bands. Entry conditions: when the closed bar has both upper and lower channel values present, a close above the upper band triggers a buy signal and a close below the lower band triggers a sell signal; additionally, it checks that the previous bar had no channel or price hadn't already broken out, ensuring a fresh breakout. Exit conditions are twofold: when the channel exists, an opposing breakout triggers position closure; when the channel disappears (no band values), the EA searches backward through bars to find the most recent channel level and determines if price is still beyond it to decide on closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management uses fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points but lacks dynamic adjustment based on ATR or volatility.

pros: 通道消失时仍有平仓逻辑，避免在无通道时持仓无法管理
支持多种平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA等），策略灵活度高
有新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复交易
买卖开仓和平仓权限可独立控制，灵活配置交易方向
首次突破检测逻辑（检查前一根K线是否已突破）减少虚假信号
pros_en: Exit logic remains active even when channel disappears, preventing unmanaged open positions
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/JJMA etc.), offering high strategy flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Buy/sell open and close permissions can be independently controlled for directional flexibility
Fresh breakout detection (checking if previous bar already broke out) reduces false signals
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未根据市场波动率动态调整，在不同行情下效果差异大
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时突破信号可能因滑点而失效
通道消失时向后遍历所有K线搜索通道值，在历史数据量大时可能造成性能问题
MM参数设计不够直观，负值表示手数、正值表示比例的逻辑容易混淆
没有多单同时存在的检查，可能在通道反复出现时连续开仓
cons_en: Fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit in points without dynamic volatility-based adjustment leads to inconsistent performance across varying market conditions
No spread filter, breakout signals may fail due to slippage when spreads widen
Backward bar iteration to find channel values when channel disappears can cause performance issues with large historical data
MM parameter design is unintuitive — negative for fixed lots, positive for deposit share — easy to confuse
No check for existing positions, may open consecutive trades when channel repeatedly appears and disappears
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR动态计算，适应不同波动率环境
增加点差过滤和最大持仓检查，防止高滑点和重复开仓
优化通道消失时的搜索逻辑，设置最大搜索K线数上限避免性能问题
improvements_en: Change StopLoss/TakeProfit to ATR-based dynamic calculation for better adaptation to different volatility regimes
Add spread filter and maximum position check to prevent high-slippage entries and duplicate positions
Optimize the backward search logic when channel disappears by setting a maximum bar search limit to avoid performance issues

risk_points: 无点差过滤，突破交易在点差扩大时可能导致不必要的亏损入场
固定止损止盈不适应市场波动变化，低波动时止盈难以达到，高波动时止损过近
缺少持仓检查，可能在短时间内重复开仓导致仓位过重
risk_points_en: No spread filter means breakout entries can result in loss-making trades when spreads widen
Fixed SL/TP doesn't adapt to market volatility — TP hard to reach in low volatility, SL too close in high volatility
No position check may lead to repeated position opening in short periods, causing overexposure
